You Fire at A1. A1 is a hit. You've found my 3-cell ship, so keep working along row 1. I fire back at B2 , and it's a miss. I've added your fleet to the board below, and my miss is marked on it. Your shot. You Fire at A2. A2 is a miss. My ship doesn't extend down from A1, so it must run along row 1 toward B1 and C1. I fire at D2 , and it's a hit . You still have all three ships, but your 2-cell ship at D1–D2 is damaged. Your shot. You Fire at A3. A3 is a miss. Column A is nearly spent, so my 3-cell ship must lie along B1 and C1. I fire at D1 , and it's a hit . That sinks your 2-cell ship at D1–D2 . You have two ships left. Your shot. You Fire at A4. A4 is a miss. Your column A shots have found only the one hit at A1, so my ship must lie along B1 and C1. I fire at C4 , and it's a miss . You still have two ships: the 3-cell at F2–F4 and the 2-cell at A5–B5. Your shot. You Fire at A5. A5 is a miss. That leaves one hit in five shots. My 3-cell ship is still along row 1, so B1 and C1 are the cells to try. I fire at F3 , and it's a hit . Your 3-cell ship at F2–F4 is damaged but afloat. You still have two ships. Your shot. You Fire at A6. A6 is a miss. Column A is finished, with one hit and five misses. My 3-cell ship is still unsunk. I fire at F2 , and it's a hit . Your 3-cell ship at F2–F4 has taken two hits and is still afloat. You still have two ships. Your shot. You How many of your ships are still afloat? All three of my ships are still afloat. Your six shots have landed one hit, at A1, on my 3-cell ship. That ship is damaged but not sunk, and my two 2-cell ships are untouched. You have two ships left. Your 3-cell ship at F2–F4 has taken two hits, so one more at F4 sinks it. Your 2-cell ship at A5–B5 is untouched. You've spent all six shots on column A, so try a different column next.
